attributes.additional_details: And some other rules like can’t go on main road motorways  and more
attributes.background: I think E scooters should be legal because some kids parents can’t drive to take them places. It also helps if a child gets angry and they need somewhere to go but they can’t walk but obviously there would be some rules to it for example it has to go under 25 KMH/ 15 mph et cetera

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this subject which you may wish to sign:

Legalise and regulate e-scooters & e-bikes exceeding current limits for road use
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/765825
